residuals.title: Agent status: host rows are never outranked by a client wall clock
Per-attempt accounting: dispatched_at at the dispatch edge, exit_code recorded, wallclock derivable
Injected (unsupervised) dispatches are reconciled on restart, never left live
Sub-agent identity is first-class, never a fabricated dispatch
Launch receipt effective comes from the installed CLI, never copied from requested
Worker liveness: an empty or non-enumerating host answer is unverifiable, never exited
Retired-incarnation tombstone never mints a proven exit from an absent status
Relay tombstone applies the same proof gate (record-torn-down is not a death)
tui-idle waits never settle on silence; evidence is carried on the wire
